visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-rimmed glasses and a dark grey t-shirt featuring a cartoon graphic is seen in a brightly lit indoor hallway. He appears fatigued, touching his forehead and chest while speaking directly to the camera in a vlog style. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a modern white kitchen where the man approaches a counter and opens a large silver stainless steel pot. Inside are numerous dark brown tea eggs soaking in liquid. He uses chopsticks to lift a tea egg and a square of marinated tofu, showing them closely to the lens. An LG branded silver refrigerator is visible in the background. (3) He is now seated at a wooden table, bringing the tea egg to his mouth and taking a large bite. His facial expressions show deep satisfaction as he chews. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the texture of the food. (4) The man stands in a white hallway with arched doorways, appearing extremely exhausted with his eyes partially closed. He continues his narrative, gesturing toward himself. (5) A first-person perspective shot follows him inside a 7-11 convenience store. He picks up various packaged food items, including a salad and a roasted chicken bento box, and places them into a black plastic shopping basket. (6) Back at a wooden table, he is surrounded by the opened 7-11 food containers. He picks up a silver can of Asahi Dry Zero and opens it. He proceeds to eat pieces of roasted chicken, salad, and ginseng soup with chopsticks and a spoon, occasionally talking to an off-camera person. (7) He holds up the nearly empty yellow bento box to show his progress. The video ends with a yellow screen featuring two minimalist cartoon characters, one sitting and one standing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo electronic background music starts immediately. The male narrator speaks with a high-pitched, slightly exaggerated tone of exhaustion. No significant ambient noise is present. (2) A metallic clink is heard as the pot lid is removed, followed by the narrator's enthusiastic shout of 'OPEN'. The music maintains its steady pulse. (3) Crisp chewing and slurping sounds are prominent as the narrator eats the tea egg and tofu. His voice rises in pitch to express excitement about the flavor. (4) A digital 'pop' sound effect marks a transition. The narrator's voice becomes lower and more rhythmic as he describes his busy day. (5) The sound of rustling plastic packaging and store ambiance filters in as he lists the items he is buying in a rhythmic, monotone fashion. (6) A sharp hiss and mechanical click are heard as a beverage can is snapped open. The narrator makes a loud 'Aah' sound of relief. (7) Faint laughter from another male voice is heard in the background. The narrator continues talking while chewing, creating soft percussive mouth sounds. (8) The background music swells slightly for the conclusion, ending with a short, bright synthesized jingle over the final graphic.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Daily Activity -> Dietary Solution -> Progress Update
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents day 76 of a 100-day weight loss journey. The creator uses a comedic, relatable vlog style to show his diet choices (low-carb tea eggs and 7-11 'Simple Fit' meals) after a long day of working on podcasts and editing. The goal is to entertain while showcasing accessible healthy food options.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display and positive review of 7-11's 'Simple Fit' series and Asahi Dry Zero non-alcoholic beer during a weight loss context.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy editing with variety-show style subtitles makes this a typical social-media native diet vlog. The focus is on the convenience of specific retail food products for weight management.
